name: Bridal makeup and wedding-day styling
what_it_is: Videos show brides and makeup artists documenting wedding-day beauty preparation — foundation-to-glam transformations, bridal hair styling, and salon getting-ready sequences — plus bridal fashion reveals in gowns and veils. Clips come from many artists and salons worldwide (Cape Town, Los Angeles, Accra, Moscow, Turkmenistan) rather than one event, with no single triggering moment.
